## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The lint flags a vague box (TestCriteriaFlagsUnfalsifiable)
- [ ] Parsing a bad file returns an error (tests with fixtures)
- [ ] `issue-cli health lint --check criteria` lists it
- [ ] The badge shows on the board (playtest step criteria-badge)
- [ ] The room keeps its colour at 390px (visual)
- [ ] The command exits 1 on a bad flag
- [ ] Rendering on the station page is covered by a guided check script
